protocol.evidence: Published experimental model, transgenic animals, mounting and recording, neural trace extraction methods
protocol.strain: NeuroPAL/GCaMP cohort SWF702 per paper; UID metadata specifies neuropal, not independent per-UID genotype confirmation
protocol.reporter: Nuclear GCaMP7f with reference fluorescence; SWF702 flvIs17 and otIs670
protocol.medium: 2% NGM agar pad with OP50 in M9 mounting buffer, coverslip with 80 micrometer bead spacers
protocol.mounting_buffer: 1 mL OP50 culture pelleted and resuspended in 40 uL M9; 9.5 uL applied
protocol.preprocessing: Publisher background correction, ROI interpolation, activity/reference division and bleaching correction; no original missing-ROI mask in released HDF5

limitations: Published cohort/mounting protocol recorded; exact per-UID genotype and recording temperature missing; coverslip/2% agar contact mechanics not calibrated

Publisher uses within-record interpolation and full-record bleach estimation; finite masks do not identify these imputed samples; no added cross-fold normalization
No full-body arclength/orientation conversion to model joints; source angles retained only
No calibrated calcium indicator likelihood or training-only normalization fitted
Nonidentity ROI index spaces quarantined until verified
Date-group folds do not establish animal-level independence; not a prospectively unseen dataset
prior_exposure: 2022-06-14 date forced train; not claimed prospectively unseen
